data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company operating in Defense & Security, a sector with 26 identifiable peers comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities. The most proximate private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic, though none operate at pre-seed stage.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable in this instance. The Defense & Security universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting minimum density thresholds—zero same-stage datapoints, one adjacent-stage company, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers were identified. Three or more comparable datapoints are required to support a reliable peer-median anchor. Constructing a median from the broader 26-company sector peer set would introduce material stage-selection bias, as most established comparables operate at later funding rounds with fundamentally different risk profiles and revenue bases than a pre-seed entity.

Given the data constraints, traditional triangulation methods cannot be reliably applied at this time. A Lodge Systems valuation would require either: (i) revenue or traction-based methodologies if such metrics exist; (ii) investor consensus from ongoing fundraising; or (iii) acquisition of additional pre-seed or seed-stage Defense & Security datapoints. The sector's capital intensity and regulatory barriers create natural sparsity in early-stage public disclosure, rendering conventional comparable-company analysis premature.
